text:
elaine: Heads up — canary p95 for decode jumped from ~70ms -> ~230ms after merge `d3a4c7` (smallseq workload). CI perf test failed.
Sam: On it, starting a bisect across recent merges. any quick suspects?
perf-bot: CI perf check: job://redwood/ci/serve-perf/3321 failed (+82% p95 on smallseq). See: https://ci.redwood/3321
Jon: I pulled a profile from a canary box. short trace:
```
  decode p95 230ms
  top kernel: generic_attn (fallback)  140ms
  next: kv_memcopy  45ms
  gpu memcpy stalls  20ms
  context switch overhead 10ms
```
Looks like attention kernel chooser picked a fallback path for many short sequences.
Rita: That's interesting — I recently changed fused-op selector heuristics to prefer `fused_attn` when `kv_present` is true. Could be a mis-tag causing fallback to generic_attn for shortseqs.
Sam: Can you paste the selector rule you changed? quick diff?
Rita: snippet: 
```
if kv_present and tokens_per_batch > 64:
    choose = fused_attn
else:
    choose = legacy_attn
```
I later added a guard to avoid smallseq, but maybe the tokens_per_batch calc is wrong for canary config.
elaine: Repro steps I ran locally: 
```
./tools/perf/run_smallseq.sh --model gpt-medium --batch 12 --seq 16
# baseline p95 ~68ms
# after merge p95 ~220ms
```
Logs show repeated `kernel fallback` messages.
Jon: I instrumented the kernel selector with counters. on canary ~45% of requests hit `chooser->fallback_path` due to `kv_present==true` but `seq_len <= 32` -> bad combo. Memory behavior shows repeated KV prefetch then eviction thrash.
Sam: Bisect points to PR #6124 (Rita) as highest probability. @Rita can you validate local repro by reverting that change?
Rita: Reverted locally and re-ran: p95 back to 72ms. Confirmed. There's also an ordering bug in the predicate: we check `kv_present` before computing `effective_tokens_per_batch` which can be stale.
Sam: I'll open a revert PR to unblock canary and follow-up with a fix PR that computes `effective_tokens_per_batch` earlier and tightens the smallseq guard.
deploy-bot: Canary hold applied to rollout ring alpha-2 (blocking further canaries).
perf-bot: Experiment: after revert PR applied to canary, CI perf (rerun) shows p95 delta -2% (within noise). job://redwood/ci/serve-perf/3324
elaine: Nice. Next steps:
- Sam: revert PR (#6132) in canary (in progress)
- Rita: fix predicate + add unit tests for `tokens_per_batch` calc
- Jon: add a micro-benchmark that exercises shortseq kv-present path
- Perf team: monitor canary for 24h
Sam: PR created: https://git.redwood/pr/6132 (revert of PR #6124). request reviews from @eng-runtime
Rita: I'll open the fix PR today and add tests + a small regression test in CI.
Jon: Also adding a tracing flag to dump kernel-selection reasons to help debug future regressions (off by default).
elaine: Thanks everyone. Recording postmortem once canary stable. :thumbsup:
